menus.note: Dinner Tuesday to Sunday; five-glass wine pairing HK$1,088, or a five-glass Korean wine pairing HK$888; galbi-jjim and Korean fried chicken can be added

menus.name: set lunch
menus.note: Wednesday to Sunday; starters, a cold dish, a bansang of tteok-galbi with rice, soup and banchan, then dessert and dagwa; wine and Korean drinks by the glass

bookingOpens: Online through SevenRooms, or by phone, WhatsApp or email. A credit card is needed to hold every booking; bookings made by phone must add the card details within 7 days or the table may be released.
cancellation: Cancellations, changes and smaller parties must be notified by phone or email at least 72 hours ahead. Within 72 hours the fee is half the menu price per person missing; on the day, the full menu price. A table is treated as a no-show 15 minutes after the booking time unless the restaurant has heard from the guest. If Typhoon Signal No. 8 or above is up two hours before the booking, it can be moved free of charge.
groups: There is a private dining room with a minimum spend. Half the minimum spend is paid as a deposit, which is lost if the booking is cancelled within 72 hours; cancelling on the day costs the full minimum spend.
children: Children who can eat the tasting menu are welcome. Babies are not recommended; contact the restaurant first if bringing one.
